milestone: M48 Headless Mode Pack Registry Refresh Continuation

strategic_capability_mapping.relationship: Lets headless.continue_once perform one authorized, replay-safe registry update selection before selected candidate fetch.
Starts the selected Mode Pack update pipeline from a trusted registry manifest through existing Rust runtime selection authority.

answers.strategic_capabilities: Advances headless_autonomous_development directly, with supporting progress for mode_pack_runtime, runtime_permission_enforcement, and persistent_structured_ledger.
answers.new_capability: headless.continue_once can select one trusted registry update candidate through existing modepack.selectRegistryUpdate authority and return a bounded route to fetch the selected candidate explicitly.
answers.why_existing_functionality_is_insufficie: modepack.selectRegistryUpdate exists as a direct RPC, but headless callers could not advance the selected update pipeline through continue_once with fresh-progress gating and replay-safe continuation checkpointing.
answers.product_gap_if_skipped: A scheduled headless update flow would still require bespoke caller glue before M46 selected fetch/provenance/approval/replacement continuations could begin.
answers.non_duplicative: Yes. M46.1 fetched a previously selected candidate, M46.2 verified selected provenance, M46.3 approved selected candidates, and M47.1 rolled back replacements; M48.1 adds the missing upstream registry selection continuation.
answers.no_new_rpc: Yes. This extends the existing headless.continue_once request/result shape and does not add a new RPC.
answers.no_new_summary: Yes. It uses existing ModePackSelectRegistryUpdateResult and bounded continuation checkpoint metadata, not a report or digest wrapper.
answers.runtime_behavior_change: The Rust runtime validates explicit authorization, fresh progress, active fingerprint, registry/provenance/signer expectations, delegates to existing registry selection authority, checkpoints the result, and replays without duplicate selection evidence or registry refetch.
answers.headless_autonomous_contribution: Scheduled callers can begin the Mode Pack registry refresh pipeline deterministically and receive the next route without relying on VSIX policy or external orchestration state.
answers.milestone_progress: M48 gains the upstream selection transition needed before the existing selected candidate fetch, provenance, approval, replacement, and rollback continuations.

guard_engine_change_review.review_intent: M48.1 archives the value gate for headless registry update selection execution.

exit_criteria: headless.continue_once accepts a bounded modepack_registry_update_selection_target with explicit registry selection and trust authorization
runtime delegates to existing modepack.selectRegistryUpdate authority and returns bounded ModePackSelectRegistryUpdateResult
same-request replay returns bounded selection evidence without duplicate ledger events or registry refetch
VSIX protocol validators accept the selection target/result shape and reject raw fields
behavior_evidence: Rust behavior test covers registry selection continuation success and next route to selected candidate fetch
Rust replay test covers no duplicate registry selection side effect for same continuation request
VSIX protocol tests validate the new bounded registry selection target/result shape and reject raw data fields
